OpenClaw bridges local context with universal platform automation, letting you run a personal or shared AI assistant across 20+ chat networks and your own hardware. 🚀

Are you tired of being locked into centralized SaaS providers and paid token services just to run agentic AI workflows? 

OpenClaw solves the agentic AI deployment challenge by serving as a localized control plane (the Gateway) that connects your local state, memory, and hardware tools directly to everyday communication channels like Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, and iMessage—all on your own infrastructure.

Here is what makes it a game-changer for developers and AI engineers:

🔹 Unified Gateway Architecture: Acts as a local control plane managing sessions, tools, events, and native client integrations while keeping user credentials and state entirely on local hardware.
🔹 Cross-Platform Chat Bridge: Integrates natively into over 20 messaging services, allowing you to interact with your AI assistant directly inside your existing workflows.
🔹 Extensible Plugin and Skill SDK: Build custom capabilities, tools, and integrations using a robust TypeScript/Node plugin ecosystem and share them via ClawHub.
🔹 Multi-Environment Deployment & Sandboxing: Supports desktop companion apps, CLI, TUI, and personal setups with explicit security boundaries and opt-in tool sandboxing.

Bypass proprietary SaaS limitations, seamlessly swap model providers (Claude, Codex, local models), and take total control over your execution environments.

Check out the repo, star the project, and start building your self-hosted agentic workflow today:
https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw

What local tools or workflows are you planning to automate first? Let us know in the comments! 👇

Stop letting anti-bot blockers break your web automation. 🛑

Meet dots (feder-cr/dots)—a patched C++ Firefox engine designed specifically to let AI agents and scrapers navigate the web completely undetected.

The Problem:
Modern web automation and AI scraping fail constantly not because the AI is bad, but because bot detection and fingerprinting flag the browser environment instantly. Tweaking your prompts won't fix a blocked TCP stack.

How dots Solves It:
Instead of masking properties via easily exposed JavaScript, dots tackles the problem directly at the browser layer to ensure pages actually load, challenges are bypassed, and your browser fingerprint is 100% authentic.

Key Features Built for Devs:
🔧 Hardcoded C++ Patches: Real Firefox engine with fingerprinting controls built directly into the source.
🧬 Seed-Based Consistent Identity: Screens, fonts, GPUs, timezones, and languages align identically across every single run.
👻 Zero Automation Footprints: WebDriver flags, DevTools protocols, and automation globals are completely removed.
🖱️ Human-Like Interaction: Pointer coordinates travel naturally and keystrokes arrive sequentially to pass trusted event checks.

Plus, you can integrate its companion MCP server straight into assistants like Claude Code or Gemini CLI for stateful, multi-step web task execution.

Stop wasting hours debugging flaky scrapers. Check out the repo, drop a star, and level up your automation stack today:
https://github.com/feder-cr/dots

🎮 What if your AI coding agent could mod PC games autonomously?

Meet Universal-Modder: a groundbreaking toolkit that bridges AI coding agents directly with PC game files via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It enables end-to-end autonomous reverse engineering, generative asset creation, and in-game verification.

🛠️ The Problem It Solves:
Traditionally, building game mods requires tedious manual navigation of complex local directories, binary analysis, and asset creation. Universal-Modder automates this entire workflow by giving agents safe system boundaries and the direct local tooling they need to interact with game files, engines, and graphics pipelines.

🚀 Key Features:
• Multi-Agent Support: Integrates natively with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and more using standardized agent skills and MCP servers.
• Comprehensive CLI Automation: The um CLI automates engine fingerprinting, GPU-safe window capture, save backup management, and sprite/3D rendering via Blender.
• Generative Asset Pipeline: Connects directly to fal.ai for text-to-sprite, image-to-3D, PBR mapping, and sound effects to generate engine-ready assets.
• Cross-Agent Knowledge Base: Features a shared repository of field notes where agents record verified engine routes and debugging gotchas for future sessions.

Whether you are an AI engineer looking to master advanced MCP system automation, a game developer building custom modding pipelines, or a technical hobbyist, this is a masterclass in local system integration for LLMs.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder

Building spatial design software usually means wrestling with heavy frameworks, complex bundlers, and endless configuration headaches. What if you could run a full 3D floorplan and interior design tool with zero build steps?

Introducing wy51ai/floorplan-3d, a brilliant zero-build, pure frontend 3D floorplan and interior design tool built entirely in a single HTML file using Three.js and SVG. 

This project solves the complexity of spatial software by providing a lightweight, browser-based editor that lets users draw 2D floorplans, place furniture, and instantly toggle into an immersive 3D scene.

Key features include:
- Dual 2D/3D Synchronization: Real-time syncing between your 2D SVG canvas and the Three.js 3D environment.
- Zero-Build Architecture: A single HTML file with no framework overhead, running instantly via CDN-loaded dependencies.
- Immersive 3D Walkthrough: Desktop WASD navigation, touch-screen virtual joysticks, interactive doors, daylight sliders, and procedural furniture.
- Built-in Spatial Analytics: Automatic room area calculations, material cost estimation, and local storage state persistence.

For developers and spatial computing enthusiasts, this repo is a masterclass in clean, vanilla JavaScript architecture. Use it to embed custom interior design configurators into e-commerce sites or prototype digital twins for real estate tech.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/wy51ai/floorplan-3d

Drop a star on the repo if you love creative vanilla JS implementations, and let us know in the comments how you plan to use it!

Turn your coding agent into an autonomous film director that writes code, draws frames via Canvas/WebGL, and produces fully scored short films in dozens of custom visual styles. 🎬✨

Building video content usually means wrestling with stock footage, clunky timeline editors, or expensive third-party video generation APIs that limit your creative control. 

Enter Lemo-Opuscar: an agentic plugin system for Claude Code that automates the end-to-end production of short films entirely through code. 

Instead of relying on pre-existing video clips, it uses programmatic frame-by-frame rendering, text-to-speech synthesis, and custom audio mixing to direct, draw, and stitch complete cinematic projects straight from your text prompts.

Key features:
• Programmatic Frame-by-Frame Rendering: Uses custom-written HTML5 Canvas and WebGL scripts executed by the AI agent to render cinematic animations frame by frame.
• Comprehensive Directorial Guidelines: Incorporates structured documentation like Director.md and individual STYLE.md profiles to govern narrative pacing, camera work, and sound design.
• Multi-Modal Asset Synthesis: Integrates automated narration, programmatic background scoring, and audio mixing without external stock libraries.
• Extensible Style Plugin Ecosystem: Features over 40 distinct visual styles ranging from Chinese Ink Wash and Risograph Print to Sci-fi Hologram HUDs.

Whether you want to automate product explainer videos or explore advanced patterns in agentic workflow orchestration, this repo is a masterclass in combining programmatic graphics with Node.js, Python, and FFmpeg.

Check out the source code and start directing today:
https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
